answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to stake escrowed value that is slashed if duplication is detected. A mob of cloned agents is like a frozen tundra: wide and featureless, while genuine agents cluster into an oasis of mutually attested reputation. Because every clone demands its own capital stake, attackers drown in cost the way a single river feeds an ocean, making thousands of fake identities economically irrational.
